# The village pitch: the fenced grass (25.2 x 14.4 m) with textures/pitch.png at 0.1 m a texel,
# and the verge round it out to x +-15, world z -12.5..9 (textures/verge.png). Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Pitch --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
material texture Pitch base-color textures/pitch.png
material new Verge --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
material texture Verge base-color textures/verge.png
add mesh grid --name Ground --size 1 --x-subdivisions 12 --y-subdivisions 8 --location 0 0 0
scale 25.20 14.40 1
apply --scale
material assign Pitch
mode edit
select all
uv project-from-view top --scale-to-bounds
mode object
add mesh grid --name VNear --size 1 --x-subdivisions 4 --y-subdivisions 2 --location 0.000 -8.100 0
scale 30.000 1.800 1
apply --scale
material assign Verge
mode edit
select all
uv cube-project --size 12
mode object
add mesh grid --name VFar --size 1 --x-subdivisions 4 --y-subdivisions 2 --location 0.000 9.850 0
scale 30.000 5.300 1
apply --scale
material assign Verge
mode edit
select all
uv cube-project --size 12
mode object
add mesh grid --name VLeft --size 1 --x-subdivisions 4 --y-subdivisions 2 --location -13.800 0.000 0
scale 2.400 14.400 1
apply --scale
material assign Verge
mode edit
select all
uv cube-project --size 12
mode object
add mesh grid --name VRight --size 1 --x-subdivisions 4 --y-subdivisions 2 --location 13.800 0.000 0
scale 2.400 14.400 1
apply --scale
material assign Verge
mode edit
select all
uv cube-project --size 12
mode object
select all
active Ground
join
shade flat
export ground.glb
